title: Lighter — close a position through the real close flow
description: From market details, presses Close, confirms in the close-position view, and verifies against the venue that no position remains. Re-entrant: when the market is already flat the UI-close leg is skipped and the unit just verifies flatness (ensure semantics via graph branching).

market.intent: Open the market page that shows the open position.

settle-market.intent: Let the position row and Close button render.

press-close.intent: Start the close flow the way a user does.

settle-close-view.intent: Let the close-position view mount with the full size preselected.

shot-close.intent: Record the close screen before confirming.

settle-confirm.intent: Give the venue time to execute the reduce-only close.

assert-flat.intent: Venue truth: the position is gone.

check.intent: Read whether a position exists so the unit can converge instead of failing on a re-run.

branch.intent: Drive the UI close only when a position exists; an already-flat market already satisfies this unit.
